name: 17-whats-new-in-7
description: What version seven adds that you can see on a screen: a game, the FSEQ player, network streams, and the Gallery.

steps.title: What is new in seven
steps.caption: What is new in seven. Games, shows and a gallery.
Version seven adds a good deal. Here are the parts you can see on a screen, starting with the effects.
Breakout joins Pong, Space Invaders and Tetrix. Every game plays itself, and a game pad or a MIDI desk can take over a paddle.
There goes the paddle after the ball. Ten seconds after the last input, the game takes the paddle back.
The FSEQ player plays shows made in xLights or Falcon Player, from flash or a microSD card, as a playlist with shuffle and loop.
A full transport: play, pause, stop, previous and next, and a position bar for the show that is playing.
Network streams, Art Net, E one thirty one and D D P, now arrive whole as well, with the Network receive effect. Presets are state documents now, saved on the pads on this card.
Under the pads sits the Gallery: presets and scripts other people published, installed with a click. The rest of what is new is in the release notes, and on the other clips of this series.
